title: The welfare trap
text: Welfare reform asks one question: how should we treat animals while we use them? Veganism asks a different one: do we have any right to use them at all? These are not two steps on the same road. They point in opposite directions. A cage-free label does not tell you to stop exploiting animals. It tells you that exploiting animals is fine. That is the trap. Every successful reform teaches the public that the use was never the problem, only the conditions. And the organisations paid to fix the conditions are the same ones that need the use to continue. Welfare organisations raise donations from people who believe the problem is being solved, and animal-use industries pay them for certifications and moral cover. Two hundred years of welfare reform have run alongside the greatest expansion of animal use in history. The wrong to address is use. Not how.
